# Intelligent Design Air Conditioning, Plumbing, Solar, Roofing & Electric

> Intelligent Design is Tucson, Arizona's highest-rated home services company—family and veteran-owned since 1979. We provide HVAC, plumbing, solar, electrical, roofing, and drain/sewer services with 22,000+ five-star reviews and a BBB A+ rating. 24/7 emergency service available. Phone: (520) 333-2665. Website: https://www.idesignac.com

## Leadership

### Andrew Dobbins - Founder, CEO & Owner
After serving as a U.S. Marine in Presidential security at HMX-1 in Quantico, VA, Andrew entered the HVAC industry in 2002. He founded Intelligent Design in 2009 with just three employees working out of a home garage. His vision: treat every customer like family, invest in the best technicians, and never compromise on quality. Andrew holds EPA certification, Building Performance Institute (BPI) certification, heat load certification, and Arizona Contractor's License credentials.

### Aimee Dobbins - Co-Founder, Culture & Customer Care
Aimee co-founded Intelligent Design alongside Andrew, building the customer experience systems and team culture that have helped maintain a near-perfect rating across 22,000+ reviews.

## Emergency Services

### 24/7 Emergency Availability
- AC failure in extreme heat (95°F+)
- Complete heating failure below 50°F
- Active water leaks causing damage
- Sewage backups
- Gas odors
- Electrical sparks or smoke
- Roof leaks during storms

### Emergency Response
- Same-day emergency service (typically 2-4 hours)
- Members receive priority emergency dispatch
- After-hours premium fees (waived/reduced for members)
- Emergency tarping for roof leaks
- Temporary solutions when permanent repairs aren't immediately possible

## Frequently Asked Questions

### General Questions

**Q: What areas do you serve?**
A: We serve Tucson and all of Southern Arizona including Oro Valley, Marana, Sahuarita, Green Valley, Vail, Catalina Foothills, and 20+ surrounding communities across 40+ zip codes.

**Q: Do you offer financing?**
A: Yes, we offer flexible financing options including 0% interest for qualified applicants (12-18 months) and extended payment plans up to 120 months.

**Q: Are your technicians licensed and insured?**
A: Yes, all technicians are licensed, insured, background-checked, and drug-tested. Our HVAC technicians are NATE-certified, and we hold active Arizona ROC licenses for HVAC, plumbing, roofing, and electrical work.

**Q: Do you offer 24/7 emergency service?**
A: Yes, we provide 24/7 emergency service for HVAC and plumbing emergencies. Call (520) 333-2665 anytime.

**Q: How do I schedule an appointment?**
A: Schedule online at idesignac.com, call (520) 333-2665, or use our live chat feature.

### HVAC Questions

**Q: How much does AC replacement cost in Tucson?**
A: AC replacement costs range from $5,500-$12,000+ depending on system size, efficiency (SEER rating), and brand. A typical 3-ton, 16-SEER system costs $6,500-$8,500 installed.

**Q: How long do AC systems last in Tucson?**
A: With proper maintenance, AC systems last 12-17 years in Tucson. Regular annual tune-ups add 3-5 years to system lifespan.

**Q: How often should I have my AC serviced?**
A: Annual tune-ups before cooling season (March-April) are recommended. Our 86-point inspection prevents 85% of breakdowns.

### Plumbing Questions

**Q: How hard is Tucson's water?**
A: Tucson's groundwater is classified as "very hard" at 12-16 grains per gallon. Water softeners significantly extend appliance life and improve water quality.

**Q: How long do water heaters last?**
A: Tank water heaters last 8-12 years in Tucson (shorter due to hard water). Tankless water heaters last 15-20 years.

**Q: What is your $28.88 drain clearing special?**
A: We offer professional drain clearing for just $28.88—one of the best values in Tucson for this service.

### Solar Questions

**Q: What tax incentives are available for solar?**
A: The federal Investment Tax Credit (ITC) provides 30% of total system cost through 2032. Arizona also offers property tax exemptions on solar equipment.

**Q: How long does solar installation take?**
A: Most residential solar installations complete in 2-4 weeks from contract to system activation.

### Roofing Questions

**Q: How long do roofs last in Tucson?**
A: Tile roofs last 50+ years, flat roofs (TPO/EPDM) last 15-25 years, shingles last 20-25 years, and metal roofs last 40-70 years.

**Q: Do you offer free roof inspections?**
A: Yes, we provide free comprehensive roof inspections before monsoon season or after storms.
